messages:
Ellie: Quick heads-up — seeing ~2x tail latency for quant-v4b on runtime 3.2 in eu-west since the unpin at 16:00. Not widespread but affects high-concurrency routes. :eyes:
Sam: Can we do a regional soft-pin for eu-west only? Keep hosted/global unaffected.
Marta: +1. Prefer pin to quant-v4b -> quant-v4b@rt3.1 (fallback), not a full runtime rollback.
Ellie: Proposed deploybot command to scope the change:
```
/deploybot pin --model=quant-v4b --target-runtime=3.1 --region=eu-west --scope=pool-A --ttl=2h --reason="latency regression post-unpin"
```
Jia: Does this need SDK changes or a client override? I can add a temporary client route but server-side routing is cleaner.
Sam: No SDK changes expected; deploybot routing maps traffic to the pinned runtime variant.
Deploybot: Scheduled pin request received: id=pin-2025-04-07-01, requester=Ellie, ttl=2h. Initiating canary (5% traffic) in pool-A.
Marta: Thx. Monitor p50/p95 and error rate. If tail latency > 1.0s or errors +0.5% alert @eng-oncall.
Ellie: Setting alerts + a short runbook. If canary looks good at 30m we can widen to 50% then 100%. :thumbsup:
Ops-bot: Alert created: eu-west-quant-v4b-latency | threshold=1.0s | notify=@eng-oncall,@sre.
Sam: If pin doesn't help we prep rollback of runtime 3.2; need infra on standby for kernel hotpatch.
Jia: I'll prep rollback checklist and a canary-to-full escalation playbook.
Ellie: I'll draft a short release-note entry and flag customers using longseq endpoints.
Marta: Rolling the pin now, please post telemetry updates here for the next 2h.
Deploybot: Action: pin applied (pin-2025-04-07-01) -> status=applied | initial-traffic=5% | pools=[pool-A].
Sam: Seeing immediate improvement on the canary p95, tail dropped ~40%. Widen after 30m if steady.
Ellie: Noting release note text: "Temporary regional pin to runtime 3.1 for quant-v4b in eu-west due to observed latency regression; mitigation applied." Will append metrics.
Marta: Good. We'll keep TTL so it auto-expires in 2h unless we unpin explicitly.
Ellie: ETA next update in ~30m. Thanks all.
